<s>oṃ sūkṣmavajradharmakrodha śodhaya hūṃ phaṭ</s>! (9)

body.text: oṃ sūkṣmavajracchedakrodha chinda bhinda huṃ phaṭ // 10 //
body.translated_text: <s>oṃ sūkṣmavajracchedakrodha chinda bhinda hūṃ phaṭ</s>! (10)

body.text: oṃ sūkṣmavajrakrodha mahācakra chinda pātaya śiraḥ praviśya hṛdayaṃ bhinda hūṃ phaṭ // 11 //
body.translated_text: <s>oṃ sūkṣmavajrakrodha mahācakra chinda pātaya śiraḥ praviśya hṛdayaṃ bhinda hūṃ phaṭ</s>! (11)

body.text: oṃ sūkṣmavajrahūṃkārakrodha hana pātaya vāṅmātreṇa hūṃ phaṭ // 12 //
body.translated_text: <s>oṃ sūkṣmavajrahūṃkārakrodha hana pātaya vāṅmātreṇa hūṃ phaṭ</s>! (12)

body.text: oṃ sūkṣmavajrakarmakrodha sarvakarmakaro bhava sarvakāryāṇi sādhaya hūṃ phaṭ // 13 //
body.translated_text: <s>oṃ sūkṣmavajrakarmakrodha sarvakarmakaro bhava sarvakāryāṇi sādhaya hūṃ phaṭ</s>! (13)

body.text: oṃ vajrasūkṣmakavacakrodha rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ phaṭ // 14 //
body.translated_text: <s>oṃ vajrasūkṣmakavacakrodha rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ phaṭ</s>! (14)

body.text: oṃ sūkṣmavajrayakṣakrodha hana bhakṣaya sarvaduṣṭān cintitamātreṇa vajradaṃṣṭra hūṃ phaṭ // 15 //
body.translated_text: <s>oṃ sūkṣmavajrayakṣakrodha hana bhakṣaya sarvaduṣṭān cintitamātreṇa vajradaṃṣṭra hūṃ phaṭ</s>! (15)

body.text: oṃ sūkṣmavajramuṣṭikrodha bandha bandha hūṃ phaṭ // 16 //
body.translated_text: <s>oṃ sūkṣmavajramuṣṭikrodha bandha bandha hūṃ phaṭ</s>! (16)
Delineation of the <s>maṇḍala</s>
Then <s>Vajrapāṇi</s> again brought forth this <s>vajra</s>-family subtle-knowledge-pledge-<s>maṇḍala</s>:

children.translated_text: Now I shall expound the supreme <s>dharma</s>-<s>maṇḍala</s>,
resembling the <s>vajradhātu</s>, known as the 'wrathful knowledge.' (1)
By the method of the great <s>maṇḍala</s>, one should draw the entire <s>maṇḍala</s>;
in the center of that, one should draw the <s>Buddha</s> situated in the center of the wisdom-<s>vajra</s>. (2)
On all sides of the <s>Buddha</s>, one should draw those very <s>mudrā</s>s;
having emerged with <s>vajra</s>-speed, in the four [quarters of the] <s>maṇḍala</s>s. (3)

body.text:
trilokavijayābhyāṃstu yathāvat tu niveśayet /
teṣāṃ tu sarvapārśvebhyo vajrakrodhān yathāvidhir // 4 // iti //
body.translated_text:
With the two <s>Trailokyavijaya</s>s, one should duly arrange;
and on all sides of those, wrathful <s>vajra</s>s, according to the rite. (4)
Initiation into the <s>maṇḍala</s>

body.text:
athātra vajrakulasūkṣmajñānamaṇḍale yathāvad vidhivistaro bhavati /
tatrādita eva tāvatpraveśya brūyād"adya tvaṃ sarvatathāgatavajrakrodhatāyāṃ vajrapāṇinā bhagavatābhiṣi[ktaṃ] tatsādhu; pratipadyasvāśeṣānavaśeṣasatvadhātuparitrāṇa yāvat sarvatathāgatahitasukhottamasiddhyavāptiphalahetorvajrakrodhe[ṇa sarva]satvānapi saṃśodhananimittaṃ mārayituṃ; kaḥ punarvādaḥ sarvaduṣṭān" iti / idamuktvā mukhabandhaṃ muñcet / tataḥ sarvamaṇḍalaṃ darśayitvā, [vajraṃ] yathāvatpāṇau datvā, tato vajrakrodhasūkṣmajñānāni śikṣayet /
body.translated_text:
Now here, the extensive rite is duly [performed] in the <s>vajra</s>-family subtle-knowledge-<s>maṇḍala</s>:
Therein, first having caused [the disciple] to enter, one should say: 'Today you have been consecrated by <s>Bhagavān Vajrapāṇi</s> in the state of wrathful <s>vajra</s> of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s — well done! Submit to destroy, through the wrathful <s>vajra</s>, even all beings for the purpose of purification, for the protection of the entire limitless and inexhaustible realm of beings, up to the attainment of the supreme accomplishment of the benefit and happiness of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s — how much more so all the wicked ones!' Having said this, one should release the face-covering. Then, having shown the entire <s>maṇḍala</s>, having duly given the <s>vajra</s> into the hand, one should then teach the wrathful <s>vajra</s> subtle-knowledge:

children.translated_text: Having firmly established the subtle <s>vajra</s>, through the yoga of the <s>vajra</s>-<s>hūṃkāra</s>,
whoever one directs the <s>hūṃkāra</s> toward — that one's life perishes. (1)
Having firmly established the subtle <s>vajra</s>, one should pervade as prescribed;

children.text: yāvattaḥ spharate taṃ tu tāvannaśyatyasau ripuḥ // 2 //
children.translated_text: as far as one pervades, that far that enemy is destroyed. (2)
Having employed the subtle <s>vajra</s> method, through the yoga of the <s>vajra</s>-<s>hūṃkāra</s>,

children.text: spharayet krodhavān yāvat tāvat satvān vināśayet // 3 //
children.translated_text: one should pervade wrathfully — as far [as one pervades], that far beings are destroyed. (3)

body.text:
tathaiva saṃharet tattu yāvadiccheta yogavān /
sarvaṃ vāpi hi niḥśeṣa punaradayāt tu jīvitam // 4 // // iti //
body.translated_text:
Similarly, one should withdraw that — as long as the <s>yogin</s> desires;
or even everything without remainder — one could restore life again. (4)

children.translated_text: Therein, these are the heart [-mantras]:
<s>hūṃ</s>!

body.translated_text: <s>hūṃ nāśaya vajra</s>!
<s>hūṃ vināśaya sarvān vajra</s>!
<s>oṃ sūkṣmavajra pratyānaya śīghraṃ hūṃ</s>!

children.text: vajraṃ tu yasya satvasya sahabhūtvā mahādṛḍhaṃ /
children.translated_text: The <s>vajra</s>, having become together with that being, greatly firm,
through the yoga of pervading with loving-kindness, pervading, one destroys through enmity. (1)
Through the yoga of pervading with enmity, compassion toward anyone,
through that yoga of compassion, one destroys all the wicked. (2)

children.text: adharmā yadi vā dharmāḥ prakṛtyā tu prabhāsvarāḥ /
children.translated_text: Whether non-<s>dharma</s>s or <s>dharma</s>s — they are by nature luminous (<s>prabhāsvara</s>);

children.text: evaṃ tu bhāvayaṃ satvāṃ huṃkāreṇa tu nāśayet // 3 //
children.translated_text: thus meditating, one destroys beings with the <s>hūṃkāra</s>. (3)
Those beings who are extremely difficult [to tame], unfit for <s>Buddha</s>-awakening,

children.text: teṣāṃ tu saṃśodhanārthāya huṃkāreṇa tu nāśayet // 4 //
children.translated_text: for the purpose of their purification, one destroys with the <s>hūṃkāra</s>. (4)
Therein, these are the heart [-mantras]:
<s>vaira vajrakrodha hūṃ phaṭ</s>!

body.translated_text: <s>karuṇā vajrakrodha hūṃ phaṭ</s>!
<s>hūṃ viśuddha vajrakrodha hūṃ phaṭ</s>!
<s>hūṃ viśodhana vajrakrodha hūṃ phaṭ</s>!

children.translated_text: Having mentally drawn a <s>vajra</s>-image of anyone,

children.text: pātayed gṛhamadhye tu tasya tannaśyate kulaṃ // 1 //
children.translated_text: one should cast it into the middle of their house — that one's family is destroyed. (1)
Likewise, through the subtle method, one should meditate on the heart-<s>vajra</s>;
casting the great <s>Bodhisattva</s>-image — one destroys the family. (2)
Meditating on the great image of <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>, wherever one casts it,

children.text: tad rājyaṃ vividhairdoṣai rājñaiva saha naśyati // 3 //
children.translated_text: that kingdom, together with the king, is destroyed by various calamities. (3)

body.text:
sarvākāravaropetaṃ buddhabimbaṃ tu bhāvayan /
pātayedyatra rājye tu tad rājyannaśyate dhruvam // 4 // iti //
body.translated_text:
Meditating on a <s>Buddha</s>-image endowed with all excellent aspects,
wherever one casts it in a kingdom — that kingdom is certainly destroyed. (4)

children.translated_text: Therein, these are the heart [-mantras]:
<s>hūṃ vajra prapāta</s>!

body.translated_text: <s>hūṃ bodhisattva prapāta</s>!
<s>hūṃ vajradhara prapāta</s>!
<s>hūṃ buddha prapāta</s>!

children.translated_text: Through the application of the subtle <s>vajra</s>, a moon-image of oneself,
meditating on oneself — wherever one falls, that one falls. (1)
A <s>vajra</s> on the moon — meditating on oneself,
wherever one falls with great anger — that family falls in an instant. (2)
Meditating on oneself as <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>,
wherever one falls — that land will soon be destroyed. (3)

body.text:
buddhabimbaṃ svamātmānaṃ bhāvayaṃ svayamātmanā /
patedyatra tu tad rājyamacireṇaiba naśyati // 4 // iti //
body.translated_text:
Meditating on oneself as a <s>Buddha</s>-image,
wherever one falls — that kingdom is destroyed before long. (4)

children.translated_text: Therein, these are the heart [-mantras]:
<s>bodhyagra prapātaya hūṃ</s>!

body.translated_text: <s>sarvavajra prapātaya hūṃ</s>!
<s>vajrasatva prapātaya hūṃ</s>!
<s>buddha prapātaya hūṃ</s>!
<s>Mudrā</s>
Then one should teach the <s>vajra</s>-family <s>dharma</s>-secret-<s>mudrā</s>-knowledge:

children.translated_text: Through the wrathful <s>vajra</s>-<s>samāpatti</s>, one should envelop one's own body;

children.text: yasya nāmnā sa mriyate saṃveṣṭan vajrahuṃkṛtaḥ // 1 //
children.translated_text: whoever by name — that one dies, being enveloped with the <s>vajra</s>-<s>hūṃkāra</s>. (1)
Having entered the subtle <s>vajra</s>, with the subtle nose, once,
through the yoga of the breath-<s>hūṃkāra</s>, one could cast down even the three worlds. (2)
Having employed the subtle <s>vajra</s> method, being wrathful, with the <s>vajra</s>-gaze,
looking — [the target] goes to blindness, or goes beyond to death. (3)

children.text: bhagena tu praviṣṭyā vai manasā yasya kasyacit /
children.translated_text: Having entered through the private parts, mentally, of anyone,

children.text: hṛdayākarṣaṇādyāti vaśaṃ svaṃ vā yamasya ve- // iti 4 //
children.translated_text: through heart-attraction, [that one] comes under one's own power, or else [goes to] <s>Yama</s>'s. (4)
Therein, these are the heart [-mantras]:

children.text: huṃ vajra valita krodha māraya huṃ phaṭ //
children.translated_text: <s>hūṃ vajra valita krodha māraya hūṃ phaṭ</s>!

body.text: oṃ vajra sūkṣma śvāsa viṣaṃ pātaya huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: <s>oṃ vajra sūkṣma śvāsa viṣaṃ pātaya hūṃ phaṭ</s>!

body.text: oṃ vajra dṛṣṭi viṣaṃ nāśaya huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: <s>oṃ vajra dṛṣṭi viṣaṃ nāśaya hūṃ phaṭ</s>!

body.text: huṃ hṛdayākarṣaṇa krodha praviśa kāyaṃ hṛdayaṃ cchinda bhinda kaḍḍhākaḍḍha phaṭ //
body.translated_text: <s>hūṃ hṛdayākarṣaṇa krodha praviśa kāyaṃ hṛdayaṃ cchinda bhinda kaḍḍhākaḍḍha phaṭ</s>!

children.translated_text: Then one should teach the <s>vajra</s>-family <s>dharma</s>-<s>mudrā</s>-knowledge:
Therein, first of all, the great <s>mudrā</s> binding is as follows:
Through the application of <s>vajra</s>-knowledge, contemplating oneself as the <s>vajra</s>-wrathful ones with splendor [like] garlands of flames,

children.text: vajrakrodhān svamātmānaṃ bhāvayaṃ siddhyati kṣaṇād // iti //
children.translated_text: one attains accomplishment in an instant.
Then one should teach the pledge-<s>mudrā</s>-knowledge of the <s>vajra</s>-family <s>dharma</s>:
The <s>samādhi</s>-knowledge-pledge, joined with the double Hūṃ-syllable,
should be established in their respective positions — the supreme bestower of all accomplishments.

body.text:
tato vajrakuladharmasamayadharmamudrājñānaṃ śikṣayet /
phaṭ saṭ maṭ saṭ raṭ taṭ dhṛṭ haṭ
paṭ traṭ ghaṭ bhaṭ kṛṭ riṭ khaṭ vaṭ
body.translated_text:
Then one should teach the <s>dharma</s>-<s>mudrā</s>-knowledge of the <s>vajra</s>-family <s>dharma</s>-pledge:
Phaṭ Saṭ Maṭ Saṭ Raṭ Taṭ Dhṛṭ Haṭ
Paṭ Traṭ Ghaṭ Bhaṭ Kṛṭ Riṭ Khaṭ Vaṭ —

body.text: iti ca proktā dharmamudrāḥ samāsata iti //
body.translated_text: thus the <s>dharma</s>-<s>mudrā</s>s have been spoken in brief.

children.translated_text: Then one should teach the karma-<s>mudrā</s>-knowledge of the <s>vajra</s>-family <s>dharma</s>-pledge:
Having divided the <s>dharma</s>-fist in two, through the application in the respective positions,

children.text: karmamudrāḥ samāsena siddhiṃ yānti yathāvidhir // iti //
children.translated_text: the karma-<s>mudrā</s>s, in brief, attain accomplishment according to the prescribed method.

body.translated_text: From the <s>vajra</s>-pledges of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s, from the great ritual manual, the detailed procedure of the <s>maṇḍala</s> of the knowledge-pledge of the <s>vajra</s>-family <s>dharma</s> is completed.
CHAPTER 9: DETAILED PROCEDURE OF THE <s>VAJRA</s>-FAMILY KARMA-<s>MAṆḌALA</s>
Emanation of deities from <s>samādhi</s>

body.text: atha bhagavān sarvatathāgatavajrakarmasamayasaṃbhavādhiṣṭhānannāma samādhiṃ samāpadyemāṃ svavidyottamāmabhāṣat oṃ sarvatathāgata karmeśvari hūṃ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bhagavān</s>, having entered the <s>samādhi</s> called the Empowerment Born from the <s>Vajra</s>-Karma-Pledge of All <s>Tathāgata</s>s, spoke this supreme <s>vidyā</s> of his own: Oṃ — Sovereign of the karma of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s! Hūṃ!

body.text: atha vajrapāṇirmahābodhisatvaḥ punarapīmāṃ svavidyottamāmabhāṣat oṃ sarvatathāgatadharmadhātuspharaṇamahāpūjākarmavidhivistarasamaye trilokavijayaṃkari sarvaduṣṭān dāmaya vajriṇi hūṃ //
body.translated_text: Then the great <s>Bodhisattva Vajrapāṇi</s> again spoke this supreme <s>vidyā</s> of his own: Oṃ — In the pledge of the detailed procedure of the great worship-activity of the pervading of the <s>dharmadhātu</s> of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s — O conqueror of the three worlds, subdue all the hostile! O <s>vajra</s>-bearer! Hūṃ!

body.text: atha vajragarbho bodhisatvaḥ punarapīmāṃ svavidyottamāmabhāṣat oṃ sarvatathāgatākāśadhātusamavasaraṇamahāpūjākarmavidhivistarasamaye hūṃ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bodhisattva Vajragarbha</s> again spoke this supreme <s>vidyā</s> of his own: Oṃ — In the pledge of the detailed procedure of the great worship-activity of the convergence of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s in the space-element! Hūṃ!

body.text: atha vajranetro bodhisatvaḥ punarapīmāṃ svavidyottamāmabhāṣat oṃ sarvatathāgatadharmadhātuspharaṇamahāpūjākarmavidhivistarasamaye hūṃ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bodhisattva Vajranetra</s> again spoke this supreme <s>vidyā</s> of his own: Oṃ — In the pledge of the detailed procedure of the great worship-activity of the pervading of the <s>dharmadhātu</s> of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s! Hūṃ!

body.text: atha vajraviśvo bodhisatvaḥ punarapīmāṃ svavidyottamāmabhāṣat oṃ sarvatathāgatasarvalokadhātuvividhamahāpūjākarmavidhivistarasamaye hūṃ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bodhisattva Vajraviśva</s> again spoke this supreme <s>vidyā</s> of his own: Oṃ — In the pledge of the detailed procedure of the manifold great worship-activity of all world-realms of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s! Hūṃ!

body.text: atha vajrapāṇirmahābodhisatvaḥ punarapi svakulapūjāvidhivistaradevatāḥ svahṛdayādutpādya, sarvalokadhātuṣu sarvatathāgatākarṣaṇavaśīkaraṇānurāgaṇasarvakarmasiddhikāryakaraṇatāsanniyojanādīni sarvatathāgatarddhivikurvitāni kṛtvā, punarapi bhagavato vairocanasya vajradhātumahāmaṇḍalayogena caṇdramaṇḍalānyāśrityāvasthitā iti /
body.translated_text: Then the great <s>Bodhisattva Vajrapāṇi</s>, having again generated from his own heart the deities of the detailed procedure of the worship of his own family, having performed all <s>Tathāgata</s> miraculous displays such as attracting, subjugating, enamoring, accomplishing all activities, and engaging in all world-realms of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s, they again stood firm having assumed [positions on] moon-disks in the arrangement of the <s>Vajradhātu</s> great <s>maṇḍala</s> of <s>Bhagavān Vairocana</s>.
Delineation of the <s>maṇḍala</s>
Then the great <s>Bodhisattva Vajrapāṇi</s> spoke this karma-<s>maṇḍala</s> of the detailed procedure of the <s>vajra</s>-karma-pledge:

children.translated_text: Now I shall explain the supreme karma-<s>maṇḍala</s>,
resembling the <s>Vajradhātu</s>, known as <s>Karmavajra</s> (Activity-<s>Vajra</s>). (1)
By the method of the great <s>maṇḍala</s>, one should outline the entire <s>maṇḍala</s>;
in the positions of the central <s>maṇḍala</s>, one should install the <s>Buddha</s>-image. (2)
On all sides of the <s>Buddha</s>, one should install the foremost pledge[-deities];
advancing with <s>vajra</s>-speed, in the four groups of <s>maṇḍala</s>s, (3)

body.text:
catvāro vajranāthādyā yathāvattu niveśayet /
teṣāṃ sarveṣu pārśveṣu mahāsatvyo niveśayed // 4 // iti //
body.translated_text:
the four <s>vajra</s>-lords beginning with [<s>Akṣobhya</s>] should be duly installed;
on all their sides, the great female beings should be installed. (4)

children.translated_text: Now here, in the karma-<s>maṇḍala</s>, the <s>vajra</s>-karma <s>mudrā</s>s are as follows:
Oṃ — In the pledge of the accomplishment-knowledge of <s>Vajrasattva</s>! Hūṃ Jaḥ! (1)

body.translated_text: Oṃ — In the pledge of the karma-knowledge of <s>vajra</s>-attraction! Hūṃ Jaḥ! (2)
Oṃ — In the pledge of the karma-knowledge of <s>vajra</s>-passion-desire! Hūṃ Jaḥ! (3)
Oṃ — In the pledge of the karma-knowledge of <s>vajra</s>-well-done! Hūṃ Jaḥ! (4)
Oṃ — <s>Vajrabhṛkuṭī</s> — subjugate! Hūṃ! (5)
Oṃ — <s>Vajra</s>-sun-<s>maṇḍala</s> — subjugate! Hūṃ! (6)
Oṃ — <s>Vajra</s>-banner-crest-armlet — subjugate! Hūṃ! (7)
Oṃ — <s>Vajra</s>-boisterous-laughter — subjugate! Hūṃ! (8)
Oṃ — <s>Vajra</s>-lotus-passion — enamor! Hūṃ! (9)
Oṃ — <s>Vajra</s>-sharp-passion — enamor! Hūṃ! (10)
Oṃ — <s>Vajra</s>-<s>maṇḍala</s>-passion — enamor! Hūṃ! (11)
Oṃ — <s>Vajra</s>-speech-passion — enamor! Hūṃ! (12)
Oṃ — In the pledge of <s>vajra</s>-karma — worship! Hūṃ! (13)
Oṃ — <s>Vajra</s>-armor-binding — protect! Hūṃ! (14)

body.text: oṃ vajrayakṣiṇi māraya vajradaṃṣṭrāyā bhinda hṛdayamamukasya huṃ phaṭ // 15 //
body.translated_text: Oṃ — <s>Vajra</s>-<s>yakṣiṇī</s> — slay! With the <s>vajra</s>-fang — pierce the heart of that one! Hūṃ Phaṭ! (15)

body.text: oṃ vajrakarmamuṣṭi siddhya siddhya huṃ phaṭ // 16 //
body.translated_text: Oṃ — <s>Vajra</s>-karma-fist — accomplish, accomplish! Hūṃ Phaṭ! (16)
Ritual

body.text: athātra karmamaṇḍale yathāvad vidhivistaraṃ kṛtvā, vajrakulakarmajñānānyutpādayet /
body.translated_text: Now here, having duly performed the detailed procedure in the karma-<s>maṇḍala</s>, one should generate the <s>vajra</s>-family karma-knowledges.

children.translated_text: Therein, from the very beginning, one should teach the knowledge of pacification-activities and the rest:
Having kindled the fire with sweet-smelling fuel-sticks, perfectly concentrated,
through the attainment of the <s>vajra</s>-wrathful [state], offering sesame seeds into the fire, one burns sins. (1)

children.text: taireva tu samidbhistu prajvālya tu hutāśanaṃ /
children.translated_text: With those very fuel-sticks, having kindled the sacrificial fire,
one who constantly offers rice grains — household prosperity surely arises. (2)
With sweet-smelling fuel-sticks too, having kindled the fire, the wise one,
offering young <s>dūrvā</s>-grass shoots with ghee — life-span increases. (3)

body.text:
taireva tu samidbhistu prajvālya tu hutāśanaṃ /
kuśapravālāṃstailena juhvan rakṣā tu śāśvatam // iti // 4 //
body.translated_text:
With those very fuel-sticks, having kindled the sacrificial fire,
offering young <s>kuśa</s>-grass shoots with oil — there is eternal protection. (4)

children.translated_text: Now, these are their heart-<s>mantra</s>s:
Oṃ — To the <s>vajra</s> that burns all sins — <s>Svāhā</s>!

body.translated_text: Oṃ — To <s>vajra</s>-prosperity — <s>Svāhā</s>!
Oṃ — To <s>vajra</s>-longevity — <s>Svāhā</s>!
Oṃ — To the unobstructed <s>vajra</s> — <s>Svāhā</s>!

children.translated_text: With hard, dry fuel-sticks at first, through the <s>vajra</s>-wrathful <s>samādhi</s>,
having kindled the fire, [offering] thorny twigs — one is attracted. (1)
With those very fuel-sticks, having kindled the fire, [being] greatly furious,
offering red flowers and fruits — one enamors the world. (2)
With fuel-sticks, enraged, having kindled the fire, the yogin,
offering iron filings — there will be <s>vajra</s>-binding. (3)
With those very fuel-sticks, having kindled the fire, concentrated,
one should offer bitter fruit; from wrathful [intent] — one produces death in an instant. (4)
Therein, these are their heart[-<s>mantra</s>s]:
Hūṃ — <s>Vajra</s> — attract! <s>Svāhā</s>!

body.translated_text: Hūṃ — <s>Vajra</s> — enamor! <s>Svāhā</s>!
Hūṃ — <s>Vajra</s> — for binding! <s>Svāhā</s>!
Hūṃ — <s>Vajra</s> — for slaying! <s>Svāhā</s>!

children.translated_text: With clean fuel-sticks, having kindled the fire, the prosperous wise one,
performing <s>homa</s> with sour fruits and flowers — this is supreme subjugation. (1)
With those very fuel-sticks, having kindled the fire, concentrated,
one should offer desire-fruits; wrathful, one attains the ability to assume any form at will. (2)
With just such fuel-sticks, having kindled the sacrificial fire,
offering stems of invisible flowers — reciting with splendor, one becomes invisible. (3)

body.text:
taireva tu samidbhistu prajvālyāgniṃ samāhitaḥ /
ākāśavallīpuṣpāṇi juhvannākāśago bhaved // iti // 4 //
body.translated_text:
With those very fuel-sticks, having kindled the fire, concentrated,
offering sky-vine flowers — one becomes a sky-goer. (4)

children.translated_text: Therein, these are their heart[-<s>mantra</s>s]:
Oṃ — To the <s>vajra</s>-subjugator — <s>Svāhā</s>!

body.translated_text: Oṃ — To the <s>vajra</s> of desire-form — <s>Svāhā</s>!
Oṃ — To the invisible <s>vajra</s> — <s>Svāhā</s>!
Oṃ — <s>Vajra</s> sky-goer goddess — <s>Svāhā</s>!

children.translated_text: With fuel-sticks of bitter potency, having kindled the fire, concentrated,
one who angrily offers <s>vajra</s>-flowers — the <s>vajra</s> becomes one's command-executor. (1)
With those very fuel-sticks, having kindled the fire, greatly furious,
whoever offers a garland in [the fire of] <s>Sūrya</s> — even that one goes into command-servitude. (2)
With those fuel-sticks, greatly enraged, having kindled the fire, concentrated,
one who offers a garland of <s>Vajrapāṇi</s> — even that one goes into command-servitude. (3)
With those very fuel-sticks, having kindled the fire, greatly furious,
the <s>Buddha</s> who offers the robes — goes into command-servitude in an instant. (4)

body.translated_text: Therein, these are their heart[-<s>mantra</s>s]:
Hūṃ — To the <s>vajra</s>-subjugator — <s>Svāhā</s>!
Hūṃ — To the <s>vajra</s> of <s>Sūrya</s>'s subjugation — <s>Svāhā</s>!
Hūṃ — To the subjugation of <s>Vajrapāṇi</s> — <s>Svāhā</s>!
Hūṃ — To the <s>vajra</s> of the <s>Buddha</s>'s subjugation — <s>Svāhā</s>!
<s>Mudrā</s>
Then one should teach the secret karma-<s>mudrā</s>-knowledge:

children.text: priyayā tu striyā sārdha saṃvasaṃstu bhage 'ñjanaṃ /
children.translated_text: Living together with a beloved woman, placing ointment in the vulva,
one should rub there — by that ointment, anointing the eyes, one brings [others] under control. (1)

children.text: manaḥśilāṃ bhaga vidhvā vajrabandhena tāṃ pighet /
children.translated_text: Having placed <s>manaḥśilā</s> (realgar) in the vulva, one should squeeze it with the <s>vajra</s>-binding;
through the four types of signs, there is also fourfold accomplishment. (2)

children.text: rocanāṃ tu bhage sthāpya guhyamuṣṭyā nipīḍayet /
children.translated_text: Having placed <s>rocanā</s> (yellow pigment) in the vulva, one should squeeze with the secret fist;
when it blazes there where placed — one becomes equal to <s>Vajradhara</s>. (3)

body.text:
kuṅkumaṃ tu bhage vidhvā tadbhagaṃ satvavajrayā /
cchāditaṃ jvālate tantu bhavedvajradharo sama // iti // 4 //
body.translated_text:
Having placed saffron in the vulva, covering that vulva with the <s>Sattvavajrā</s> —
when it blazes there, that one becomes equal to <s>Vajradhara</s>. (4)

children.translated_text: Therein, these are their heart[-<s>mantra</s>s]:
Oṃ — <s>Vajra</s>-secret — passion-subjugator — accomplish! Hūṃ!

body.translated_text: Oṃ — <s>Vajra</s>-secret — accomplish! Hūṃ!
Oṃ — Secret-<s>vajra</s> — accomplish! Hūṃ!
Oṃ — <s>Vajradhara</s>-secret — accomplish! Hūṃ!
Then one should teach the <s>vajra</s>-family karma great <s>mudrā</s>-knowledge:

children.translated_text: through the attainment of the <s>vajra</s>-wrathful [state], through the application of the <s>vajra</s>-fist. (1)

body.translated_text: Through the application of <s>vajra</s>-activity, the great <s>mudrā</s>s in brief —

children.translated_text: The foremost pledges likewise here, through the yoga of the Hūṃ-syllable finger;
the <s>dharma</s>-<s>mudrā</s>s likewise here, with the syllables beginning with Oṃ. (2)
The karma-<s>mudrā</s>s in brief — the karma-fist divided in two —
pure, producers of all accomplishments, through the application of <s>vajra</s>-activity. (3)

body.translated_text: From the <s>vajra</s>-pledges of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s, from the great ritual manual, the detailed procedure of the <s>vajra</s>-family karma-<s>maṇḍala</s> is completed.

body.text:
CHAPTER 10 MAHA-KALPA-VIDHI-VISTARA
Emanation of deities form samadhi
body.translated_text:
CHAPTER 10: DETAILED PROCEDURE OF THE GREAT RITUAL MANUAL
Emanation of deities from <s>samādhi</s>

body.text: atha bhagavān punarapi sarvatathāgatavajrasamayamudrādhiṣṭhānaṃ nāma samādhiṃ samāpadyemāṃ sarvavidyottamamabhāṣat oṃ sarvatathāgatavajrasamaye hūṃ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bhagavān</s>, having again entered the <s>samādhi</s> called the Empowerment of the <s>Vajra</s>-Pledge-<s>Mudrā</s> of All <s>Tathāgata</s>s, spoke this supreme <s>vidyā</s> of all: Oṃ — In the <s>vajra</s>-pledge of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s! Hūṃ!

body.text: atha vajrapāṇirmahābodhisatva imāṃ svavajrasasayamudrāmabhāṣat huṃ vajri maṭ //
body.translated_text: Then the great <s>Bodhisattva Vajrapāṇi</s> spoke this <s>vajra</s>-pledge-<s>mudrā</s> of his own: Hūṃ — <s>Vajra</s>-bearer! Maṭ!

body.text: atha vajragarbho bodhisatva imāṃ svaratnasamayamudrāmabhāṣat huṃ bhṛkuṭivajre raṭ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bodhisattva Vajragarbha</s> spoke this jewel-pledge-<s>mudrā</s> of his own: Hūṃ — <s>Bhṛkuṭī</s>-<s>vajra</s>! Raṭ!

body.text: atha vajranetro bodhisatvo mahāsatva imāṃ svadharmasamayamudrāmabhāṣat hūṃ padmavajri triṭ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajranetra</s> spoke this <s>dharma</s>-pledge-<s>mudrā</s> of his own: Hūṃ — Lotus-<s>vajra</s>-bearer! Triṭ!

body.text: atha vajraviśvo bodhisattvo mahāsatva imāṃ svakarmasamayamudrāmabhāṣat hūṃ vajrakarmāgri kṛṭ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajraviśva</s> spoke this karma-pledge-<s>mudrā</s> of his own: Hūṃ — Supreme <s>vajra</s>-activity! Kṛṭ!
Delineation of the <s>maṇḍala</s>
Then the great <s>Bodhisattva Vajrapāṇi</s> again spoke this <s>Trailokyavijaya</s> (Conquest of the Three Worlds) four-<s>mudrā</s> <s>maṇḍala</s>:

children.translated_text: Now I shall explain the supreme <s>mudrā</s>-<s>maṇḍala</s>,
resembling the <s>Vajradhātu</s>, known as <s>Krodhavajra</s> (Wrathful-<s>Vajra</s>). (1)

body.text:
mahāmaṇḍalayogena sūtrayet sarvamaṇḍalam /
trilokavijayādyāṃstu likhedbuddhasya sarvata // iti // 2 //
body.translated_text:
By the method of the great <s>maṇḍala</s>, one should outline the entire <s>maṇḍala</s>;
the [deities] beginning with <s>Trailokyavijaya</s> should be drawn on all sides of the <s>Buddha</s>. (2)
<s>Mudrā</s>

body.text: athātra caturmudrāmaṇḍale mahāmaṇḍalayogenākarṣaṇādividhivistaraṃkṛtvā praveśya caturmudrāmaṇḍalaṃ guhyamudrājñānaṃ śikṣayet /
body.translated_text: Now here, in the four-<s>mudrā</s> <s>maṇḍala</s>, having performed the detailed procedure of attraction and the rest by the method of the great <s>maṇḍala</s>, having led [the disciple] into the four-<s>mudrā</s> <s>maṇḍala</s>, one should teach the secret <s>mudrā</s>-knowledge:

children.translated_text: Having drawn the four-<s>mudrā</s> <s>maṇḍala</s> oneself, [contemplating] the pure nature of <s>dharma</s>,
reciting, living together with a woman — accomplishment is attained. (1)
Having drawn the four-<s>mudrā</s> <s>maṇḍala</s> oneself, [contemplating] the pure nature of <s>dharma</s>,
reciting, gazing at a woman with passion — accomplishment is attained. (2)
Having drawn the four-<s>mudrā</s> <s>maṇḍala</s> oneself, [contemplating] the pure nature of <s>dharma</s>,
setting in motion, kissing a beautiful woman — one attains accomplishment. (3)
Having drawn the four-<s>mudrā</s> <s>maṇḍala</s> oneself, [contemplating] the pure nature of <s>dharma</s>,
reciting, embracing [her] — all accomplishments are attained. (4)
Therein, these are the <s>mudrā</s>s of the pure nature of <s>dharma</s>:
Oṃ — Pure <s>dharma</s>-nature of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s! Hoḥ!

body.translated_text: OṂ — <s>Vajra</s>-purified-vision! JAḤ!
OṂ — In the mouth of inherent purity! HŪṂ!
OṂ — <s>Vajra</s> of totally purified body, speech, and mind-action! HAN!
Then one should teach the secret <s>mudrā</s> of the four-<s>mudrā</s>-<s>maṇḍala</s> mystery.

children.translated_text: Having entered this <s>maṇḍala</s>, with the five excellent qualities of desire,
delighting with the consorts of others, one especially attains accomplishment.

body.translated_text: Now here is the heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: HO VAJRAKĀMA!

body.text: tato yathāvad vajrākrāntitriśūlamudrādyāḥ catasraḥ samayamudrāḥ savidhivistarāḥ śikṣayitvā, tena caturmudrāprayogeṇa vajravādyatūryatālān niryātya, vajrasatvasaṃgrahahṛdayagītiṃ gāyatā mudrāpratimudropamudrājñānamudrābhirnṛtyopahārapūjā kāryati /
body.translated_text: Then, having duly taught the four pledge-<s>mudrā</s>s beginning with the <s>vajra</s>-trampling-trident <s>mudrā</s> with their detailed procedures, through the application of the four <s>mudrā</s>s one should produce <s>vajra</s> instruments, drums, and cymbals, and while singing the song of the heart that gathers <s>Vajrasattva</s>, one should perform the dance-offering-worship with the <s>mudrā</s>, counter-<s>mudrā</s>, sub-<s>mudrā</s>, and knowledge-<s>mudrā</s>.
Here is the dance-offering-worship:

children.translated_text: Through the <s>vajra</s>-dance application, [with] the two <s>vajra</s>-wrathful fingers,
one should bind the <s>Vajra</s>-HŪṂ-<s>kāra</s> <s>mudrā</s> at the heart. (1)

children.text: tathaiva nṛtyan vāmāṃ tu gṛhya dakṣiṇamuṣṭinā /
children.translated_text: Dancing likewise, grasping the left [hand] with the right fist,

children.text: parivartya lalāṭo tu niveśyāgryā mukhena ta // 2 //
children.translated_text: turning at the forehead, one should place [it] with the tips facing the mouth. (2)
Then, dancing, having released [the hands], with equally cupped joined [palms],
placing the tipped <s>añjali</s> at the heart, one should bow with trembling devotion. (3)

body.text:
vajrakrodhāṅgulī samyaguttāramukhasandhite /
parivartya tathoṣṇīṣe tu tarjanī mukhasusthitā // 4 // iti //
body.translated_text:
The <s>vajra</s>-wrathful fingers, properly joined face-upward,
turning at the <s>uṣṇīṣa</s> (crown-protuberance), with the index finger well-placed at the mouth. (4)
II.6 — <s>Ekamudrāmaṇḍala</s> (Single-<s>Mudrā</s> <s>Maṇḍala</s>)
Then the great <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>Vajrapāṇi</s> again uttered this, his own <s>vajra</s>-pledge wrathful pledge: HŪṂ!
Delineation of the <s>maṇḍala</s>
Now here is his <s>maṇḍala</s>:

children.translated_text: Now I shall proclaim the supreme secret <s>maṇḍala</s>,
resembling the <s>Vajradhātu</s>, designated as the <s>Vajra</s>-HŪṂ-<s>kāra</s>. (1)
According to the method of the great <s>maṇḍala</s>, one should draw the outer <s>maṇḍala</s>.
In its center, one should properly draw the <s>vajra</s>-holder on a moon-disc. (2)

body.text:
savajra vajrahuṃkāramahāmudrākaragrahaṃ /
pratyālīḍhasusaṃsthānaṃ yathāvad varṇarūpiṇam // iti // 3 //
body.translated_text:
Holding the great <s>mudrā</s> of the <s>Vajra</s>-HŪṂ-<s>kāra</s> with the <s>vajra</s>,
in the well-established <s>pratyālīḍha</s> stance, with the proper colors and form. (3)
<s>Mudrā</s>

children.translated_text: Now here, having performed the complete procedure for all accomplishments in the secret <s>maṇḍala</s>, one should proclaim the secret <s>mudrā</s>-knowledge of the <s>Vajra</s>-HŪṂ-<s>kāra</s>.
Having entered this <s>maṇḍala</s>, the <s>Trailokyavijaya</s> finger —

children.text: sādhaye tu bhage bidhvā sarvakarma susidhyati //
children.translated_text: one should accomplish by piercing the <s>bhaga</s> (vulva) — all actions are perfectly accomplished.

body.text: athāsya sādhanahṛdayaṃ bhavati huṃ vajrasamaya kṛta //
body.translated_text: Now here is the accomplishment heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: HŪṂ — <s>Vajra</s>-pledge accomplished!
Then one should teach the <s>mudrā</s>-knowledge of the secret accomplishment of the <s>Vajra</s>-HŪṂ-<s>kāra</s>.

children.translated_text: Having properly entered the <s>maṇḍala</s>, established in the foremost great <s>mudrā</s>,
cohabiting as the <s>Vajra</s>-HŪṂ-<s>kāra</s>, one would become the doer of all actions.

body.text: tatrāsyāḥ sādhanahṛdayaṃ bhavati huṃ vajrasamaya huṃ //
body.translated_text: Here is the accomplishment heart[-<s>mantra</s>] of that: HŪṂ — <s>Vajra</s>-pledge! HŪṂ!

body.text: tato yathāvan mudrābandhacatuṣṭayaṃ śikṣayet / tathaiva siddhayaḥ saṃbhavantīti //
body.translated_text: Then one should duly teach the fourfold <s>mudrā</s>-binding. Accomplishments arise in the same way.

body.text: yathā maṇḍale evaṃ paṭādiṣu likhitānāṃ sarvapratimāsvapi sāmānyā siddhiriti /
body.translated_text: Just as in the <s>maṇḍala</s>, so too for images drawn on cloth and the rest, the general accomplishment applies to all representations.

body.text: atha vajrapāṇiḥ sarvatathāgatānāhūyaivamāha / "adhitiṣṭhata bhagavantaḥ sarvatathāgatā mame[daṃ kulaṃ ye ca] sarvasatvā yathākāmakaraṇīyatayā sarvasiddhīḥ prāpnuyur" iti //
body.translated_text: Then <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>, having summoned all the <s>Tathāgata</s>s, spoke thus: 'Empower, <s>Bhagavān</s>s, all <s>Tathāgata</s>s, this family of mine, so that all beings may attain all accomplishments by doing as they wish!'

body.text: atha bhagavantaḥ sarvatathāgatāḥ punaḥ samājamāgamyāsya trilokavijayakalpasyādhiṣṭhānāyedamūcuḥ /
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bhagavān</s>s, all the <s>Tathāgata</s>s, having again assembled, for the empowerment of this <s>Trailokyavijaya</s> ritual, spoke thus:

children.text: sādhu te vajrasatvāya vajraratnāya sādhu te /
children.translated_text: Well done for <s>Vajrasattva</s>! Well done for <s>Vajraratna</s>!

children.text: vajradharmāya te sādhu sādhu te vajrakarmaṇe //
children.translated_text: Well done for <s>Vajradharma</s>! Well done for <s>Vajrakarma</s>!
This <s>sūtra</s> is well-spoken — the unsurpassed <s>Vajrayāna</s>,
the secret of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s, the compendium of the <s>Mahāyāna</s>.

body.translated_text: From the great pledge of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s, from the great ritual-text (<s>mahākalparāja</s>), the detailed procedure of the great ritual is completed.
CHAPTER 11 — <s>TRILOKACAKRA-MAHĀ-MAṆḌALA-VIDHI-VISTARA</s>

body.text: atha bhagavantaḥ sarvatathāgatāḥ punarapi samājamāpadya jānanneva vajrapāṇiṃ mahābodhisatvamevamāhuḥ / "pratipadyasva vatsa sarvatathāgatājñākāritayai imaṃ maheśvarakāyamataḥ svapādatālāt mokṣum!" iti / atha bhagavāṃ vajrapāṇistāṃstathāgatānevamāha / "ahaṃ bhagavadbhiḥ sarvaduṣṭadamakaḥ krodha ityabhiṣiktaḥ / tanmayāyaṃ vyāpāditaḥ, tatkathamasya mokṣāmī?" ti /
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bhagavān</s>s, all the <s>Tathāgata</s>s, having again assembled, knowing [the situation], spoke thus to the great <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>: 'Proceed, O son, by the command of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s — release this body of <s>Maheśvara</s> from under your foot!' Then the <s>Bhagavān Vajrapāṇi</s> spoke thus to those <s>Tathāgata</s>s: 'I, <s>Bhagavān</s>s, have been consecrated as the wrathful subduer of all evil ones. By me, this one was slain. How then shall I release him?'

body.text: atha sarvatathāgatā maheśvarasya sarvatrilokādhipateḥ śarīrasya jīvitasaṃjananahetoridaṃ mṛtavijñānākarṣaṇahṛdayaṃ svahṛdaye[bhyo niścaranti /] oṃ vajrasatva hūṃ jjaḥ //
body.translated_text: Then all the <s>Tathāgata</s>s, for the purpose of generating life in the body of <s>Maheśvara</s>, the lord of the entire three worlds, caused this heart[-<s>mantra</s>] for attracting the consciousness of the dead to issue forth from their hearts: OṂ — <s>Vajrasattva</s> HŪṂ JAḤ!
And here is the <s>mudrā</s>-binding:

body.text:
guhyāṅkuśī dṛḍhīkṛtya samāntyāsu prasāritā /
mṛtasya mūrdhni sandhāya [punarjīvitaṃ prāpsyata // iti //]
body.translated_text:
Having firmly made the secret hook, extended with the tips joined,
placing it on the head of the dead — [the dead one] will regain life.

body.text: athāsmin viniḥsṛtamātre sa bhagavān [bhasmeśvaranirghoṣas] tathāgato bhasmacchatrāyā lokadhātor [āgamya, tasya] maheśvara[sya kāye praviṣṭvā, idamudānamudānayāmāsa /]
body.translated_text: And at the very moment this issued forth, the <s>Bhagavān</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s> <s>Bhasmeśvaranirghoṣa</s> (Roar of the Lord of Ashes), having come from the <s>Bhasmacchatrā</s> world-realm, having entered the body of <s>Maheśvara</s>, uttered this inspired utterance (<s>udāna</s>):

children.translated_text: Oh! Indeed, the <s>Buddha</s>-knowledge of all <s>Buddha</s>s is unsurpassed,
by which even this dead body has come to the state of a living being!

body.translated_text: Then the great <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>Vajrapāṇi</s> uttered this heart[-<s>mantra</s>]

body.text: mahābodhisatva idaṃ pādoccārannāma hṛdayamudājahāra oṃ vajra muḥ //
body.translated_text: called 'foot-raising': OṂ VAJRA MUḤ!
And here is the <s>mudrā</s>-binding:

Having raised the <s>vajra</s>-wrathful fingers with the tips joined,
turning the two <s>vajra</s>s, one should lift up from below.

body.text: athāsmin bhāṣitamātre mahāvajradharapādamūlān mahādevo [muktayitvā punaḥ saṃjīvīkṛtaḥ /] atha maheśvara[kāyaṃ tena tathāgatena saṃ]jīvamadhiṣṭhāya, svayauvarājyatāyāmatraiva lokadhātau sarvasatva[hitārthañca duṣṭa]vinayārthaṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpitavāniti //
body.translated_text: And at the very moment this was uttered, <s>Mahādeva</s>, having been released from the feet of the great <s>Vajradhara</s>, was brought back to life. Then, having empowered the body of <s>Maheśvara</s> with that <s>Tathāgata</s> who restored [him to] life, [<s>Vajrapāṇi</s>] established [<s>Maheśvara</s>] in the role of viceroy in this very world-realm, for the benefit of all beings and for the disciplining of evil ones.

body.text: atha tato vajrapāṇi caraṇatalādimāṃ candrapādānnāma sarvatathāgatabodhicittamudrāṃ [viniḥsṛtaḥ /] oṃ candrottare samantabhadrakiraṇī mahāvajriṇi hūṃ //
body.translated_text: Then from the sole of <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>'s foot, this <s>bodhicitta</s>-<s>mudrā</s> of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s called 'Moon-Feet' issued forth: OṂ — <s>Candrottara</s> (Moon-Supreme), <s>Samantabhadra</s>-ray, great <s>vajra</s>-holder! HŪṂ!
And here is the <s>mudrā</s>-binding:

children.translated_text: Having firmly made the <s>vajra</s>-binding, with the little fingers and thumbs raised,
having raised and well-extended [them] — it is called 'Moon-Light.'

body.text: athāsyāṃ viniḥsṛtamātrāyāṃ tata eva pādatalāc candrottara eva tathāgato [niścacāra, tasya maheśvarasya śire vajrapāṇi pādāvakrānte tadardhacandramūrdhanabhiṣikto, vajrapāṇervāmapārśve sthitaḥ / tataḥ] sarvatathāgatai[rvajrapāṇermitrasya pāṇau] vajraśūlaṃ datvā, vajravidyottamo vajravidyottama iti vajranāmābhiṣekeṇābhiṣiktaḥ //
body.translated_text: And at the very moment this issued forth, from that very sole of the foot, the <s>Tathāgata</s> <s>Candrottara</s> (Moon-Supreme) himself emerged. When <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>'s feet were placed upon the head of that <s>Maheśvara</s>, he was consecrated on his half-moon crown, and stood at the left side of <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>. Then by all the <s>Tathāgata</s>s, a <s>vajra</s>-trident was given into the hand of <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>'s companion, and he was consecrated with the <s>vajra</s>-name consecration as '<s>Vajravidyottama</s>! <s>Vajravidyottama</s>!'

body.text: atha vajravidyottamo bodhisattvo [mahāsattvaśca] tena vajraśūlena cakraparivartanagatyā nṛtyopahārapūjāṃ kurvannidamudānamudānayāmāsa /
body.translated_text: Then the <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>mahāsattva</s> <s>Vajravidyottama</s>, performing the dance-offering-worship with that <s>vajra</s>-trident in a wheel-turning motion, uttered this inspired utterance:

children.translated_text: Oh! Indeed, the <s>bodhicitta</s> of all <s>Buddha</s>s is unsurpassed,
by which even through the mere touch of the tip of [his] foot, <s>Buddha</s>hood is attained by me!

body.text: atha vajrapāṇirmahābodhisatvaḥ, tato vajrakrodhasamādhervyutthāya, bhagavantame[tāṃ vācamuvāca] / "ahaṃ bhagavaṃ sarvatathāgatairvajraṃ pāṇibhyāṃ datvā vajrapāṇitvenābhiṣiktaḥ // tadeṣāṃ devādīnāṃ bāhyavajrakulānāmasmiṃ trilokavijayamahāmaṇḍale sthānaviniyogaṅkariṣyāmi / yena te satvā avaivartikā bhaviṣyanti anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhāv" iti //
body.translated_text: Then the great <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>, having arisen from the <s>vajra</s>-wrathful <s>samādhi</s>, addressed the <s>Bhagavān</s> with these words: 'I, <s>Bhagavān</s>, have been consecrated by all <s>Tathāgata</s>s as <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>, having been given the <s>vajra</s> in my hands. Therefore, I shall assign the positions of these <s>deva</s>s and other outer <s>vajra</s>-families in this <s>Trailokyavijaya</s> great <s>maṇḍala</s>, so that those beings will become irreversible from unsurpassed perfect awakening.'

body.text: atha bhaga[vān vairocanas] tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddha idaṃ sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣamudājahāra oṃ vajrasatvoṣṇīṣa huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bhagavān</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s> <s>Vairocana</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One, uttered this <s>uṣṇīṣa</s> (crown-protuberance) [<s>mantra</s>] of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s: OṂ — <s>Vajrasattva</s>-<s>uṣṇīṣa</s>! HŪṂ PHAṬ!

body.text: athāsmin bhāṣitamātre sarvatathāgatoṣṇī[ṣemyo viniḥsṛto bhagavadvajrapāṇivigrahaḥ, nānā]varṇaraśmayo bhūtvā, sarvalokadhātavo 'vabhāsya, punarapi bhagavato vajrapāṇermūdham [anupariveṣṭitāḥ, sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣatejorāśiṃ bhūtvā] sthitaḥ / atha tatastejorāśita idaṃ sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣaṃ niścacāra / oṃ namassarvatathāga[toṣṇīṣa] tejorāśi anavalokitamūrdha hūṃ jvāla dhaka vidhaka dara vidara huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: And at the very moment this was uttered, from the <s>uṣṇīṣa</s>s of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s there emerged a form of the <s>Bhagavān Vajrapāṇi</s>, which, having become rays of various colors, illuminated all world-realms, and again encircled the crown of the <s>Bhagavān Vajrapāṇi</s>, becoming a mass of radiance from the <s>uṣṇīṣa</s>s of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s and standing [there]. Then from that mass of radiance, this <s>uṣṇīṣa</s> [<s>mantra</s>] of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s issued forth: OṂ — Homage to the <s>uṣṇīṣa</s>s of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s! Mass of radiance! O you of the unlooked-upon crown! HŪṂ — Blaze! Burn! Tear! Rend! HŪṂ PHAṬ!

body.text: atha vajrapāṇirbodhisatvo mahāsatva idaṃ svavidyottamamudā[jahāra]oṃ nisuṃbha vajra huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>mahāsattva</s> <s>Vajrapāṇi</s> uttered this, his own supreme <s>vidyā</s>: OṂ NISUṂBHA VAJRA HŪṂ PHAṬ!

body.text: tataḥ punarapi vajrapāṇiḥ svahṛdayādidaṃ hṛdayamudājahāra oṃ ṭṭakki jjaḥ //
body.translated_text: Then again, <s>Vajrapāṇi</s> uttered this heart[-<s>mantra</s>] from his own heart: OṂ ṬṬAKKI JAḤ!

body.text: atha vajragarbho bodhisatvo mahāsatva idaṃ svavidyottamamabhāṣat oṃ vajra ratnottama jvālaya huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>mahāsattva</s> <s>Vajragarbha</s> uttered this, his own supreme <s>vidyā</s>: OṂ — <s>Vajra</s>-jewel supreme — blaze! HŪṂ PHAṬ!

body.text: atha vajranetro bodhisatvo mahāsatva idaṃ svavidyottamamabhāṣat oṃ svabhāvaśuddha vajrapadma śodhaya sarvān vidyottama huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>mahāsattva</s> <s>Vajranetra</s> uttered this, his own supreme <s>vidyā</s>: OṂ — Inherently pure <s>Vajra</s>-lotus — purify all! Supreme <s>vidyā</s>! HŪṂ PHAṬ!

body.text: atha vajraviśvo bodhisattvo mahāsatva imaṃ svavidyottamamabhāṣat oṃ vajrakarmottama vajradhara samayamanusmara suṃbhanisuṃbhākarṣaya praveśayāveśaya bandhaya samayaṃ grahaya sarvakarmāṇi me kuru mahāsatva huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>mahāsattva</s> <s>Vajraviśva</s> uttered this, his own supreme <s>vidyā</s>: OṂ — Supreme <s>vajra</s>-action! <s>Vajradhara</s>, remember the pledge! <s>Suṃbha</s>, <s>Nisuṃbha</s> — attract, cause to enter, make to enter, bind! Grasp the pledge! Perform all actions for me, O great being! HŪṂ PHAṬ!

body.text: atha vajravidyottamo bodhisatvo mahāsatva idaṃ svahṛdayaṃ bhagavato vajrapāṇeḥ pādavandanīyaṃ niryātayāmāsa oṃ suṃbha nisuṃbha vajravidyottama huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>mahāsattva</s> <s>Vajravidyottama</s> surrendered this, his own heart[-<s>mantra</s>], as a foot-homage to the <s>Bhagavān Vajrapāṇi</s>: OṂ — <s>Suṃbha</s>, <s>Nisuṃbha</s> — <s>Vajravidyottama</s>! HŪṂ PHAṬ!

body.text: atha krodhavajro vidyārājo bhagavataścaraṇayornipatyeda svahṛdayamadāt huṃ vajraśūla //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>vidyā</s>-king <s>Krodhavajra</s> (Wrathful Vajra), falling at the feet of the <s>Bhagavān</s>, gave this, his own heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: HŪṂ VAJRAŚŪLA!

body.text: atha māyāvajro vidyārājedaṃ svahṛdayamabhāṣat oṃ vajramāya vidarśaya sarva huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>vidyā</s>-king <s>Māyāvajra</s> (Illusion Vajra) uttered this, his own heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: OṂ — <s>Vajra</s>-illusion — display all! HŪṂ PHAṬ!

body.text: atha vajraghaṇṭo vidyārājaḥ svahṛdayamadāt oṃ vajraghaṇṭa raṇa raṇa huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>vidyā</s>-king <s>Vajraghaṇṭa</s> (Vajra Bell) gave this, his own heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: OṂ — <s>Vajra</s>-bell — ring, ring! HŪṂ PHAṬ!

body.text: atha maunavajraḥ svahṛdayamadāt oṃ vajramauna mahāvrata huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then <s>Maunavajra</s> (Silent Vajra) gave this, his own heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: OṂ — <s>Vajra</s>-silence — great vow! HŪṂ PHAṬ!

body.text: atha vajrāyudhaḥ svahṛdayamadāt oṃ vajrāyudha dāmaka huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then <s>Vajrāyudha</s> (Vajra Weapon) gave this, his own heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: OṂ — <s>Vajra</s>-weapon — subduer! HŪṂ PHAṬ!
These are the <s>vidyā</s>-kings (<s>vidyārāja</s>s).

body.text: atha vajrakuṇḍalirvajrakrodho bhagavate vajrapāṇaye idaṃ svahṛdayaṃ pādavandanīyaṃ niryātayāmāsa / oṃ vajrakuṇḍali mahāvajrakrodha guhṇa hana daha paca vidhvaṃsaya / vajreṇa mūrdhānaṃ sphālaya bhinda hṛdayaṃ vajrakrodha huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>vajra</s>-wrathful one <s>Vajrakuṇḍali</s> surrendered this, his own heart[-<s>mantra</s>], as a foot-homage to the <s>Bhagavān Vajrapāṇi</s>: OṂ — <s>Vajrakuṇḍali</s>, great <s>vajra</s>-wrathful one — seize, strike, burn, cook, scatter! With the <s>vajra</s>, split the crown! Pierce the heart! <s>Vajra</s>-wrathful one! HŪṂ PHAṬ!

body.text: atha vajraprabho vajrakrodha idaṃ svahṛdayamadāt / oṃ vajraprabha māraya saumyakrodha huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>vajra</s>-wrathful one <s>Vajraprabha</s> (Vajra Radiance) gave this, his own heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: OṂ — <s>Vajraprabha</s> — slay! Gentle-wrathful one! HŪṂ PHAṬ!

body.text: atha vajradaṇḍo vajrakrodhaḥ svahṛdayamadāt / oṃ vajradaṇḍa tanuya sarvaduṣṭān mahākrodha huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>vajra</s>-wrathful one <s>Vajradaṇḍa</s> (Vajra Staff) gave this, his own heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: OṂ — <s>Vajradaṇḍa</s> — punish all evil ones! Great wrathful one! HŪṂ PHAṬ!

body.text: atha vajrapiṅgalo vajrakrodha idaṃ svahṛdayamadāt / oṃ vajrapiṅgala bhīṣaya sarvaduṣṭān bhīmakrodha huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>vajra</s>-wrathful one <s>Vajrapiṅgala</s> (Vajra Tawny One) gave this, his own heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: OṂ — <s>Vajrapiṅgala</s> — terrify all evil ones! Terrifying wrathful one! HŪṂ PHAṬ!
These are the <s>vajra</s>-wrathful ones (<s>vajrakrodha</s>s).

body.text: atha vajraśauṇḍo gaṇapatirbhagavate vajrapāṇaye idaṃ hṛdayanniryātayati sma / oṃ vajraśauṇḍa mahāgaṇapati rakṣa sarvaduṣṭebhyo vajradharājñāṃ pālaya huṃ phaṭ /
body.translated_text: Then <s>Vajraśauṇḍa</s> (Vajra Fierce One), the <s>gaṇapati</s> (lord of hosts), surrendered this heart[-<s>mantra</s>] to the <s>Bhagavān Vajrapāṇi</s>: OṂ — <s>Vajraśauṇḍa</s>, great <s>gaṇapati</s> — protect from all evil ones! Guard the command of <s>Vajradhara</s>! HŪṂ PHAṬ!

body.text: atha vajramāla idaṃ svahṛdayamadāt / oṃ vajramāla gaṇapataye mālayākarṣaya praveśayāveśaya bandhaya vaśīkuru māraya huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then <s>Vajramāla</s> (Vajra Garland) gave this, his own heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: OṂ — <s>Vajramāla</s>, for the <s>gaṇapati</s> — attract with a garland, cause to enter, make to enter, bind, subjugate, slay! HŪṂ PHAṬ!

body.text: atha vajravaśī svahṛdayamadāt / oṃ vajravaśī mahāgaṇapate vaśīkuru huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then <s>Vajravaśī</s> (Vajra Subjugator) gave this, his own heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: OṂ — <s>Vajravaśī</s>, great <s>gaṇapati</s> — subjugate! HŪṂ PHAṬ!

body.text: atha vijayavajro gaṇapatiḥ svahṛdayamadāt / oṃ vajravijaya vijayaṃ kuru mahāgaṇapati huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then <s>Vijayavajra</s> (Victorious Vajra), the <s>gaṇapati</s>, gave this, his own heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: OṂ — <s>Vajravijaya</s> — make victorious, great <s>gaṇapati</s>! HŪṂ PHAṬ!
These are the <s>gaṇapati</s>s (lords of hosts).

body.text: atha vajramusalo vajradūta idaṃ svahṛdayaṃ vajrapāṇaye niryātayāmāsa / oṃ vajramusala kṛṭṭa kuṭṭa sarvaduṣṭān vajradūtahuṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then <s>Vajramusala</s>, the <s>vajra</s>-messenger, offered this heart[-<s>mantra</s>] of his own to <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>: <s>oṃ vajramusala kṛṭṭa kuṭṭa sarvaduṣṭān vajradūta huṃ phaṭ</s>!
Then <s>Vajrānila</s>, the messenger, gave his own heart[-<s>mantra</s>]

body.text: nilo dūtaḥ svahṛdayamadāt / oṃ vajrānila mahāvegānaya sarvaduṣṭān huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: : <s>oṃ vajrānila mahāvegānaya sarvaduṣṭān huṃ phaṭ</s>!

body.text: atha vajrānalo dūtaḥ svahṛdayamadāt / oṃ vajrānala mahādūta jvālaya sarva bhasmīkuru sarvaduṣṭān huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then <s>Vajrānala</s>, the messenger, gave his own heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: <s>oṃ vajrānala mahādūta jvālaya sarva bhasmīkuru sarvaduṣṭān huṃ phaṭ</s>!

body.text: atha vajrabhairavo dūtaḥ svahṛdayamadāt / oṃ vajrabhairava vajradūta bhakṣaya sarvaduṣṭān mahāyakṣa huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then <s>Vajrabhairava</s>, the messenger, gave his own heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: <s>oṃ vajrabhairava vajradūta bhakṣaya sarvaduṣṭān mahāyakṣa huṃ phaṭ</s>!
[These are the] messengers (<s>dūta</s>).

body.text: atha vajrāṅkuśo vajraceṭa idaṃ svahṛdayaṃ bhagavate vajrapāṇaye niryātayāmāsa / oṃ vajraṅkuśākarṣaya sarva mahāceṭa huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then <s>Vajrāṅkuśa</s>, the <s>vajra</s>-servant (<s>ceṭa</s>), offered this heart[-<s>mantra</s>] of his own to the Blessed One <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>: <s>oṃ vajrāṅkuśākarṣaya sarva mahāceṭa huṃ phaṭ</s>!

body.text: atha vajrakālaḥ svahṛdayamadāt / oṃ vajrakāla mahāmṛtyumutpādaya huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then <s>Vajrakāla</s> gave his own heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: <s>oṃ vajrakāla mahāmṛtyumutpādaya huṃ phaṭ</s>!

body.text: atha vajravināyakaḥ svahṛdayamadāt / oṃ vajravināyakāsya vighnaṃ kuru huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then <s>Vajravināyaka</s> gave his own heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: <s>oṃ vajravināyakāsya vighnaṃ kuru huṃ phaṭ</s>!

body.text: atha nāgavajra idaṃ svahṛdayaṃ bhagavate vajrāpāṇaye pādavandanīyaṃ niryatayāmāsa / oṃ nāgavajrānaya sarvadhanadhānyahiraṇyasuvarṇamaṇimuktālaṅkārādīni sarvopakaraṇāni vajradhara samayamanusmarakaḍḍha gṛhṇa bandha hara hara prāṇān mahāceṭa huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then <s>Nāgavajra</s> offered this heart[-<s>mantra</s>] of his own, worthy of foot-veneration, to the Blessed One <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>: <s>oṃ nāgavajrānaya sarvadhanadhānyahiraṇyasuvarṇamaṇimuktālaṅkārādīni sarvopakaraṇāni vajradhara samayamanusmara kaḍḍha gṛhṇa bandha hara hara prāṇān mahāceṭa huṃ phaṭ</s>!
[These are the] servants (<s>ceṭa</s>).

body.text: atha vajrapāṇirmahābodhisatva idaṃ sarvavajrakulākarṣaṇasamayamudājahāra oṃ vajrāṅkuśākarṣaya huṃ //
body.translated_text: Then <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>, the great <s>bodhisattva</s>, proclaimed this pledge of attracting all <s>vajra</s>-families: <s>oṃ vajrāṅkuśākarṣaya huṃ</s>!
Then he proclaimed the pledge of entering: <s>huṃ vajrapāśākaḍḍha huṃ</s>!
Then he proclaimed the pledge of binding: <s>huṃ vajrasphoṭa vaṃ</s>!

body.text: tataḥ karmahṛdayamudājahāra oṃ vajrakarma sādhaya kṛt //
body.translated_text: Then he proclaimed the action-heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: <s>oṃ vajrakarma sādhaya kṛt</s>!
Delineation of the <s>maṇḍala</s>

children.translated_text: Then <s>Vajrapāṇi</s> spoke this great <s>maṇḍala</s> of all <s>vajra</s>-families:
'Now, from here I shall teach the supreme great <s>maṇḍala</s>,
resembling the <s>Dharmacakra</s> — one should draw the threads of the entire <s>maṇḍala</s>.'

body.text: tatredaṃ sūtraṇahṛdayaṃ bhavati oṃ vajrasūtrākarṣaya sarvamaṇḍalān huṃ //
body.translated_text: Therein, this is the thread-drawing heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: <s>oṃ vajrasūtrākarṣaya sarvamaṇḍalān huṃ</s>!

children.text: maṇḍalasya tu madhye vai vidhvā khadirakīlakaṃ /
children.translated_text: 'In the very center of the <s>maṇḍala</s>, having driven in a <s>khadira</s>-wood peg,

children.text: tatastu sūtraṃ dviguṇaṃ kṛtvā tena prasūtrayet //
children.translated_text: then, having doubled the thread, one should draw [the lines] with it.'

body.text: tatredaṃ kīlakahṛdayaṃ / oṃ vajrakīla kīlaya sarvavidhnān bandhaya hūṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Therein, this is the peg heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: <s>oṃ vajrakīla kīlaya sarvavidhnān bandhaya hūṃ phaṭ</s>!

children.translated_text: 'Furnished with four threads, one should draw the wheel-<s>maṇḍala</s>;

children.text: bāhyatastasya niḥkramya dviguṇaṃ tu tathaiva ca // 1 //
children.translated_text: going outward from that, doubled likewise.' (1)

body.text:
tasyāpi triguṇaṅkuryāt bāhyamaṇḍalasūtraṇaṃ /
vidiśāścārayogena koṇarekhāstu sūtrayed // iti // 2 //
body.translated_text:
'Of that too, one should make the outer <s>maṇḍala</s> drawing threefold;
and the corner-lines should be drawn with the diagonal connection.' (2)
Procedure for thread-drawing.

children.text: tatastu sūtraṇaṃ tattu raṅgaiḥ śuddhaistu pūrayet /
children.translated_text: 'Then that thread-drawing should be filled in with pure pigments;
with the left <s>vajra</s>-great-fist, [drawing] the forward line as convenient.'

body.text: tatredaṃ raṅgahṛdayaṃ / oṃ vajraraṅga samaya hūṃ //
body.translated_text: Therein, this is the pigment heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: <s>oṃ vajraraṅga samaya hūṃ</s>!

children.translated_text: 'Then the <s>vajra</s>-<s>ācārya</s>, being stationed in the center, concentrated,
should mentally open the four <s>vajra</s>-gates.'

body.text: tatredaṃ dvārodghāṭanahṛdayaṃ / oṃ vajrodghāṭanasamaya praviśa śīghraṃ smara vajrasamaya huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Therein, this is the gate-opening heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: <s>oṃ vajrodghāṭanasamaya praviśa śīghraṃ smara vajrasamaya huṃ phaṭ</s>!

children.translated_text: 'On gold, silver, or on clay well-painted,

children.text: iṣṭake tu caturaśre tu buddhabimbaṃ niveśayet //
children.translated_text: or on a square tile, one should place the <s>Buddha</s>-image.'

body.translated_text: Therein, this is the heart[-<s>mantra</s>] of all <s>Buddha</s>s: <s>oṃ sarvavid</s>!

children.translated_text: 'Around the <s>Buddha</s> on all sides, one should make the four great beings;
making <s>Trilokavijaya</s>, with <s>Vajrapāṇi</s> stationed in front.'
Therein, these are the heart[-<s>mantra</s>]s of the four great beings:

children.text: oṃ suṃbha nisuṃbha huṃ gṛṇha gṛṇha huṃ gṛṇha pya huṃ ānaya ho bhagavan vajra huṃ phaṭ // 1 //
children.translated_text: <s>oṃ suṃbha nisuṃbha huṃ gṛṇha gṛṇha huṃ gṛṇhapya huṃ ānaya ho bhagavan vajra huṃ phaṭ</s>! (1)

body.text: oṃ vajrabhṛkuṭi krodhānaya sarvaratnān hīḥ phaṭ // 2 //
body.translated_text: <s>oṃ vajrabhṛkuṭi krodhānaya sarvaratnān hīḥ phaṭ</s>! (2)

body.text: oṃ vajradṛṣṭi krodhadṛṣṭyā māraya huṃ phaṭ // 3 //
body.translated_text: <s>oṃ vajradṛṣṭi krodhadṛṣṭyā māraya huṃ phaṭ</s>! (3)

body.text: oṃ vajraviśva krodha kuru sarvaṃ viśvarūpatayā sādhaya hūṃ phaṭ // 4 //
body.translated_text: <s>oṃ vajraviśva krodha kuru sarvaṃ viśvarūpatayā sādhaya hūṃ phaṭ</s>! (4)

children.translated_text: 'Whether entering or exiting, the thread beneath, mentally [directed] —

children.text: vajravega iti khyātastena rekhāṃ samākramed // iti //
children.translated_text: known as <s>Vajravega</s> (Vajra-speed) — with that one should trace the lines.'

body.translated_text: Therein, this is the <s>Vajravega</s> heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: <s>vajravega</s>!

children.translated_text: 'Having exited with <s>Vajravega</s>, the first <s>maṇḍala</s> likewise —
in proper sequence, one should draw <s>Vajramāyā</s> and the rest.'
Therein, these are their pledge heart[-<s>mantra</s>]s:
<s>oṃ vajracakra hūṃ</s>! (1)

body.translated_text: <s>oṃ vajraghaṇṭa hūṃ</s>! (2)
<s>oṃ vajradaṇḍakāṣṭha hūṃ</s>! (3)
<s>oṃ vajrāyudha hūṃ</s>! (4)

children.translated_text: 'Having proceeded with <s>Vajravega</s> to the second <s>maṇḍala</s> likewise,
one should place the <s>vajra</s>-wrath [deities], beginning with <s>Vajrakuṇḍalī</s>.'
Therein, these are their heart[-<s>mantra</s>]s:
<s>oṃ prajvalita pradīptavajra hūṃ</s>! (1)

body.translated_text: <s>oṃ vajrasaumya hūṃ</s>! (2)
<s>oṃ vajradaṇḍa hūṃ</s>! (3)
<s>oṃ vajravikṛta huṃ</s>! (4)

children.translated_text: 'Then with <s>Vajravega</s>, one should draw at the four gates —
<s>Vajraśauṇḍa</s> and the rest, all in proper sequence.'
Therein, these are their pledge heart[-<s>mantra</s>]s:
<s>oṃ vajramada huṃ</s>!

body.translated_text: <s>oṃ vajramāle hūṃ</s>!
<s>oṃ vajrārtha hūṃ</s>!
<s>oṃ vajrāśi hūṃ</s>!

children.translated_text: 'Having proceeded with <s>Vajravega</s> to the third <s>maṇḍala</s>, one should draw
in proper sequence <s>Vajramusala</s> and the rest.'
Therein, these are their heart[-<s>mantra</s>]s:
<s>oṃ vajramusala hūṃ</s>!

body.translated_text: <s>oṃ vajrapaṭa hūṃ</s>!
<s>oṃ vajrajvāla hūṃ</s>!
<s>oṃ vajragraha hūṃ</s>!

children.translated_text: 'Having proceeded with <s>Vajravega</s> to the fourth <s>maṇḍala</s>, one should draw
the <s>vajra</s>-servants beginning with <s>Vajrāṅkuśa</s>, in proper sequence.'

body.translated_text: Therein, these are their heart[-<s>mantra</s>]s:
<s>oṃ vajradaṃṣṭra hūṃ</s>!
<s>oṃ vajrāmāraṇa hūṃ</s>!
<s>oṃ vajravidhna hūṃ</s>!
<s>oṃ vajraharaṇa huṃ</s>!

children.translated_text: 'Having exited with <s>Vajravega</s>, established in the outer <s>maṇḍala</s>,
one should draw all the mothers (<s>mātṛ</s>s) in proper sequence.' (1)

body.text:
vajradvāreṣu sarveṣu dvārapālāsta eva tu /
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvadvidhivistaram // 2 // iti //
body.translated_text:
'At all the <s>vajra</s>-gates, those very ones are the gate-guardians;
from here onward I shall teach the detailed procedure as appropriate.' (2)

body.text: athātra trilokacakramahāmaṇḍale ākarṣaṇādikarma kṛtvā, svayaṃ vajrācāryo vajrakrodhaterintirimudrāṃ badhvā, evaṃ brūyād, "ahante vajrasamayajñānamutpādayiṣyāmi / tattvayā na kasyacidvaktavyaṃ / mā te viṣamā parihāreṇa kālakriyayā narakapatanaṃ syād," idamuktvedaṃ śapathahṛdayaṃ dadyāt / vajrakrodhaterintirimudrāṃ badhvā darśayet "ayaṃ vajrakrodhasamayaste sandahet kulan, murdhādārabhya kāyaṃ tu nāśayet, yadyatikramet samayaṃ bandhaya" //
body.translated_text: Then, in this <s>Trilokacakra</s> great <s>maṇḍala</s>, having performed the attraction and other actions, the <s>vajra</s>-<s>ācārya</s> himself, having bound the <s>vajra</s>-wrath <s>terintiri</s>-<s>mudrā</s>, should say thus: 'I shall generate for you the <s>vajra</s>-pledge-knowledge. Therefore you must not tell anyone. Lest through irremediable danger, by the event of death, you fall into hell.' Having said this, one should give this oath-heart[-<s>mantra</s>]. Having bound the <s>vajra</s>-wrath <s>terintiri</s>-<s>mudrā</s>, one should show [it, saying]: 'This <s>vajra</s>-wrath-pledge will burn your family, will destroy the body beginning from the crown, if you transgress the pledge — bind!'

body.text: tato vajradhāri karmamudrāṃ bandhayedanena hṛdayena oṃ sarvatathāgata vajradhara gṛhṇa bandha samaya hūṃ //
body.translated_text: Then one should bind the <s>vajra</s>-holder action-<s>mudrā</s> with this heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: <s>oṃ sarvatathāgata vajradhara gṛhṇa bandha samaya hūṃ</s>!
Now there is the binding of this <s>mudrā</s>:

children.translated_text: 'With the little finger and thumb bound, the two hands above and below —
this <s>mudrā</s> is proclaimed as the action-pledge-<s>vajra</s>-bond.'

body.text: tato vajra odakenābhiṣiñcedanena hṛdayena oṃ vajrābhiṣekābhiṣiñca vajradharatve samaya gra gra //
body.translated_text: Then one should consecrate with <s>vajra</s>-water, with this heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: <s>oṃ vajrābhiṣekābhiṣiñca vajradharatve samaya gra gra</s>!

body.text: tato naktakena mukhaṃ badhvā [praveśayatya] nena hṛdayena oṃ praviśa vajra praveśaya vajra āviśa vajra ādhitiṣṭha vajra hūṃ //
body.translated_text: Then, having covered the face with a cloth, one should cause [the disciple] to enter with this heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: <s>oṃ praviśa vajra praveśaya vajra āviśa vajra ādhitiṣṭha vajra hūṃ</s>!

body.text: tataḥ praveśya puṣpāṇi kṣipet anena hṛdayena oṃ pratīcchādhitiṣṭha vajra hoḥ //
body.translated_text: Then, having caused [the disciple] to enter, one should cast flowers with this heart[-<s>mantra</s>]: <s>oṃ pratīcchādhitiṣṭha vajra hoḥ</s>!
Then, wherever [the flower] falls — that [deity] becomes his accomplishment.

body.text: tato mukhabandhaṃ muktvā, maṇḍalaṃ yathānupūrvato darśayet / na cāsya vaktavyaṃ kiṃ deva iti / tatkasmāddhetoḥ? santi satvā mithyādṛṣṭayo ye na śraddhāsyanti, kimetadamoghaṃ buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ jñānaṃ, yathā tathāgatā vajrakule vajrapāṇinābhiṣiktāstathāgatā eveti samayaḥ / anyatra ye deve bhaktāsteṣāṃ śapathahṛdayaṃ datvā vācyamiti /
body.translated_text: Then, having removed the face-covering, one should show the <s>maṇḍala</s> in due order. And one should not tell [the disciple] 'which deity.' For what reason? There are beings of wrong views who will not have faith, [thinking:] 'Is this unfailing knowledge of the <s>Buddha</s>-<s>Bhagavān</s>s [real]? Just as the <s>Tathāgata</s>s have been consecrated in the <s>vajra</s>-family by <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>, they are <s>Tathāgata</s>s indeed' — this is the pledge. Otherwise, for those who are devoted to [their own] gods, having given them the oath-heart[-<s>mantra</s>], one should tell [them].

body.text: tato vajraratnacinhamālābhiṣekaṃ datvā, karmavajraṃ pāṇibhyāmabhiprayacchya, vajranāma kuryāt, yathā vajrasamayamahāmaṇḍala iti //
body.translated_text: Then, having given the <s>vajra</s>-jewel-emblem-garland consecration, having bestowed the action-<s>vajra</s> with both hands, one should give the <s>vajra</s>-name, just as in the <s>Vajrasamaya</s> great <s>maṇḍala</s>.
<s>Mudrā</s>
Then one should teach the great <s>mudrā</s>-binding:

children.translated_text: 'Having made firm the <s>vajra</s>-bond, with the thumbs inserted and gathered,
proceeding with curved tips — this is designated the <s>Sattvoṣṇīṣa</s> (Being-Crown).' (1)
'Having established the <s>vajra</s>-bond, with the thumbs and middle [fingers] of one's own,
known as <s>Tejorāśi</s> (Mass of Splendor), of the great being <s>Tejorāśi</s>.' (2)
'Having bound the <s>vajra</s>-<s>mudrā</s> twofold, with the little fingers and thumbs joined,
with a firm hook-binding — of the supreme great <s>vidyā</s>.' (3)
'Having bound the <s>mudrā</s> made of the supreme great <s>vidyā</s>, well-controlled,
by the binding of the thumb-tips at the heart — it is known as the heart [<s>mudrā</s>].' (4)
'That very [<s>mudrā</s>], well-controlled with the ring, middle, and [other] fingers,
through the application of the <s>vajra</s>-jewel, reversed, stationed at the face.' (5)
'That very one in the upturned position, reversed at one's own heart,
named the four-petaled — of the supreme lotus-<s>vidyā</s>.' (6)

body.text:
tāmeva mūrdhādārabhya bhramatkāyāgramaṇḍalā /
vajraviśvasya mudreyaṃ vajrakarmaprasādhike // ti // 7 //
body.translated_text:
'That very one, beginning from the crown, the revolving body-tip <s>maṇḍala</s> —
this is the <s>mudrā</s> of <s>Vajraviśva</s>, the accomplisher of <s>vajra</s>-action.' (7)

children.translated_text: 'Having made firm the <s>sattva</s>-<s>vajra</s>, with the little fingers joined in the <s>vajra</s> [position],
this is the <s>mudrā</s> of <s>Sarvavid</s>-heart, the accomplisher of all.' (8)
'With the little finger and thumb bound, with the left three middle fingers
as a trident — the middle prong being the <s>vajra</s>-<s>mudrā</s> holder.' (9)
'This is [the <s>mudrā</s>] of the supreme <s>vajra</s>-<s>vidyā</s>, proclaimed as <s>Vajraśūla</s> (Vajra-Trident);
from here onward I shall teach [those] designated <s>Māyāvajra</s> and the rest.' (10)
'Having made firm the <s>vajra</s>-bond, one should bind the left <s>vajra</s>;
this is known as the <s>vajra</s>-fist (<s>vajramuṣṭi</s>), in all <s>vajra</s>-families.' (1)
'Having made that <s>vajra</s> twofold, with all emblems placed,
one should place [them] in the <s>mudrā</s>s of all <s>vajra</s>-families.' (2)
'With extended tips at the back, with the elder [finger] grasping the thumb below,

children.text: oṃkāra mūrdhni saṃsthā tu vajra caiva pratiṣṭhitā // 3 //
children.translated_text: the <s>oṃ</s>-syllable stationed at the crown — and the <s>vajra</s> is established.' (3)

body.translated_text: The group of great <s>mudrā</s>s of the <s>vidyā</s>-kings.

children.translated_text: 'Resting extended on the palm, or likewise on the back of the hand,

children.text: muṣṭisaṃsthā bhujā vā ca mukhataḥ parivartitā //
children.translated_text: stationed in the fist, or on the arm, reversed from the mouth.'

body.translated_text: The group of great <s>mudrā</s>s of the <s>vajra</s>-wrath [deities].

children.translated_text: 'Well-stationed with the left thumb, applied with the garland-binding,
with the right [hand] granting benefit, the sword-<s>mudrā</s> with tip-fist.'

body.translated_text: The group of great <s>mudrā</s>s of <s>Gaṇapati</s>.

children.translated_text: 'Grasping the pestle on the right, with arm extended likewise,
showing flame on the right, shaken with the <s>vajra</s>-fist.'

body.translated_text: The group of great <s>mudrā</s>s of the messengers (<s>dūta</s>).

children.translated_text: 'With the proud mouth-fang-tips, cast down with the staff-blow,
hanging with contracted arm, seizing with left and right.'

body.translated_text: The group of great <s>mudrā</s>s of the servants (<s>ceṭa</s>).

children.translated_text: 'All construction in the <s>maṇḍala</s> with the left-<s>vajra</s> grip;

children.text: ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi sādhanaṃ karma eva ca // 1 //
children.translated_text: from here onward I shall teach the practice and the action as well.' (1)

children.text: yasya satvasya yā mudrā bhavettasya svamātmanā /
children.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>mudrā</s> belongs to whatever being, [visualizing] that as one's own self —
visualizing oneself — the supreme <s>mudrā</s>-practice.' (2)

body.text:
manoṣṇīṣamahārakṣā tejorāśī susiddhadā /
sarvakṛdvajrahuṃkārā sarvākarṣā tu hṛdgate // ti // 3 //
body.translated_text:
'The mind-crown is the great protector; <s>Tejorāśi</s> grants great accomplishment;
<s>Sarvakṛd</s>-<s>vajra</s>-<s>hūṃkāra</s> attracts all when [stationed] at the heart.' (3)
<s>Buddha</s>-<s>mudrā</s>s:

children.translated_text: '<s>Sarvavid</s> grants all accomplishments; the supreme <s>vajra</s>-<s>vidyā</s>;
<s>Vajraśūlā</s>, the great <s>mudrā</s>, the granter of great accomplishment.' (1)
'<s>Māyāvajra</s> grants good accomplishment; <s>Samāveśā</s> is the bell;

children.text: daṇḍakāṣṭhā tu nairvāṇī vajravajrā tu māraṇī // 2 //
children.translated_text: <s>Daṇḍakāṣṭhā</s> is the <s>nirvāṇa</s> [-granting one]; <s>Vajravajrā</s> is the slayer.' (2)

body.translated_text: [These are] the <s>vidyā</s>-queens.

children.translated_text: The flame-chief is the tamer of the wicked; the gentle-chief is the all-slaying one.

children.text: daṇḍāgrā ghātanī caiva bhīmākṣī tu bhayaṅkarī //
children.translated_text: The staff-chief is the striker; the terrible-eyed one is the fear-maker.

body.translated_text: <s>Vajra</s>-wrathful ones.

children.text: madanī madanī tīvraṃ mālā sarvakarī smṛtā /
children.translated_text: The intoxicating one intoxicates intensely; the garland is called the all-doer.
The desiring one is the beloved-maker; the slaying one is the all-slayer.

body.translated_text: Retinue-<s>mudrā</s>s.

children.translated_text: The pestle is the destroyer of the wicked; the cloth and the cord-cloth likewise.
The flame-chief is the tamer of the wicked; the <s>yakṣiṇī</s> is the seizer of planets.

body.translated_text: Messenger-<s>mudrā</s>s.

children.translated_text: The devouring one is the <s>vajra</s>-fang; the slaying one is the all-slayer.
The great obstacle-maker is the creator of obstacles; the stealing one is the all-stealer.

body.translated_text: Servant-<s>mudrā</s>s.
The elaboration of the procedure of the <s>Trilokacakra</s> great <s>maṇḍala</s>, from the great <s>kalpa</s>-king of the <s>vajra</s>-pledge of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s, is fully completed.

body.text:
CHAPTER 12 SARVA-VAJRA-KULA-VAJRA-MANDALA-VIDHI-VISTARA
Emanation of deities from samadhi
body.translated_text:
CHAPTER 12: <s>SARVA-VAJRA-KULA-VAJRA-MAṆḌALA-VIDHI-VISTARA</s>
Emanation of Deities from <s>Samādhi</s>

body.text: atha bhagavān punarapi sarvatathāgatavajradhāraṇīsamayasaṃbhavādhiṣṭhānannāma samādhiṃ samāpadyemāṃ svavidyottamāmabhāṣat oṃ vajrasāvitre svāhā //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bhagavān</s>, having again entered the <s>samādhi</s> called 'the empowerment born from the pledge of the <s>vajra</s>-<s>dhāraṇī</s> of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s,' spoke this supreme <s>vidyā</s> of his own: 'Oṃ <s>vajrasāvitre svāhā</s>!'

body.text: atha vajrāpāṇirmahābodhisatvaḥ punarapīmaṃ svavidyottamāmabhāṣat oṃ vajradhāri hūṃ // vajravikrame hūṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then the great <s>Bodhisattva Vajrapāṇi</s> again spoke this supreme <s>vidyā</s> of his own: 'Oṃ <s>vajradhāri</s> hūṃ! <s>Vajravikrame</s> hūṃ phaṭ!'

body.text: atha vajragarbho bodhisattvo mahāsatva imāṃ svavidyottamāmabhāṣat oṃ vajraratnagotre svāhā //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajragarbha</s> spoke this supreme <s>vidyā</s> of his own: 'Oṃ <s>vajraratnagotre svāhā</s>!'

body.text: atha vajranetro bodhisatvo mahāsatva imāṃ svavidyottamāmabhāṣat oṃ vajrapadmanetre hūṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajranetra</s> spoke this supreme <s>vidyā</s> of his own: 'Oṃ <s>vajrapadmanetre</s> hūṃ phaṭ!'

body.text: atha vajraviśvo bodhisatvo mahāsatva imāṃ svavidyottamāmabhāṣat oṃ vajrakarmakari hūṃ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajraviśva</s> spoke this supreme <s>vidyā</s> of his own: 'Oṃ <s>vajrakarmakari</s> hūṃ!'

body.text: atha vajravidyottamo bodhisattva imāṃ svavidyottamāmabhāṣat oṃ vajraśūlāgre svāhā //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bodhisattva Vajravidyottama</s> spoke this supreme <s>vidyā</s> of his own: 'Oṃ <s>vajraśūlāgre svāhā</s>!'

body.text: atha vajramāyo vidyārāja imāṃ svamudrāmabhāṣat oṃ vajracakre hūṃ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>vidyā</s>-king <s>Vajramāya</s> spoke this <s>mudrā</s> of his own: 'Oṃ <s>vajracakre</s> hūṃ!'
<s>Vajraghaṇṭa</s> said: 'Oṃ <s>vajraghaṇṭike</s> hūṃ!'
<s>Maunavajra</s> said: 'Oṃ <s>vajradaṇḍakāṣṭhe</s> hūṃ!'
<s>Vajrāyudha</s> said: 'Oṃ <s>vajre</s> hūṃ!'
<s>Vidyā</s>-king pledge-<s>mudrā</s>s.

body.text: atha vajrakuṇḍalirvajrakrodha imāṃ samayamudrāmabhāṣat oṃ jvālāvajre hūṃ //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>vajra</s>-wrathful one <s>Vajrakuṇḍali</s> spoke this pledge-<s>mudrā</s>: 'Oṃ <s>jvālāvajre</s> hūṃ!'

body.text: atha vajraprabha uvāca oṃ vajrasaumye hūṃ //
body.translated_text: Then <s>Vajraprabha</s> said: 'Oṃ <s>vajrasaumye</s> hūṃ!'
<s>Vajradaṇḍa</s> said: 'Oṃ <s>vajradaṇḍe</s> hūṃ!'
<s>Vajrapiṅgala</s> said: 'Oṃ <s>vajrabhīṣaṇe</s> hūṃ!'
<s>Vajra</s>-wrathful pledge-<s>mudrā</s>s.

body.text: atha vajraśauṇḍaḥ svasamayamudrāmabhāṣat oṃ vajrameda hūṃ //
body.translated_text: Then <s>Vajraśauṇḍa</s> spoke his own pledge-<s>mudrā</s>: 'Oṃ <s>vajrameda</s> hūṃ!'
<s>Vajramāla</s> said: 'Oṃ <s>vajramāle</s> hūṃ!'
<s>Vajravaśya</s> said: 'Oṃ <s>vajravaśe</s> hūṃ!'
<s>Vijayavajra</s> said: 'Oṃ <s>vajrāparājite</s> hūṃ!'
<s>Vajra</s>-retinue-lord pledge-<s>mudrā</s>s.

body.text: atha vajramusalaḥ svasamayamudrāmudājahāra oṃ vajramusalagrahe hūṃ //
body.translated_text: Then <s>Vajramusala</s> uttered his own pledge-<s>mudrā</s>: 'Oṃ <s>vajramusalagrahe</s> hūṃ!'
<s>Vajrānila</s> said: 'Oṃ <s>vajrapaṭe</s> hūṃ!'
<s>Vajrānala</s> said: 'Oṃ <s>vajrajvāle</s> hūṃ!'
<s>Vajrabhairava</s> said: 'Oṃ <s>vajragrahe</s> hūṃ!'
<s>Vajra</s>-messenger pledge-<s>mudrā</s>s.
Then <s>Vajrāṅkuśa</s> said: 'Oṃ <s>vajradaṃṣṭre</s> hūṃ!'
<s>Vajrākāla</s> said: 'Oṃ <s>vajramāraṇi</s> hūṃ!'
<s>Vajravināyaka</s> said: 'Oṃ <s>vajravighne</s> hūṃ!'
<s>Nāgavajra</s> said: 'Oṃ <s>vajrahāriṇi</s> hūṃ!'
<s>Vajra</s>-servant pledge-<s>mudrā</s>s.
Delineation of the <s>Maṇḍala</s>
Then <s>Vajrapāṇi</s> again spoke this <s>vajra</s>-<s>maṇḍala</s> of all <s>vajra</s>-families:

children.translated_text: Now I shall fully explain the supreme <s>vajra</s>-<s>maṇḍala</s>.
One should string the outer <s>maṇḍala</s>, square, with the door to the north. // 1 //
Inside of that, and likewise with the eastern door,
in the center of that, one should install the <s>Buddha</s>-image as appropriate. // 2 //
<s>Trilokavijaya</s> and the rest — four on all sides of that.
Of the <s>maṇḍala</s>, O best one, one should draw the <s>vajra</s>-<s>mudrā</s>s likewise. // 3 //
On all sides of those, one should draw the family-<s>mudrā</s>s.
<s>Vajraśauṇḍa</s> and the rest — four door-guardians. // 4 //

children.text: bhīmāṃ śriyaṃ sarasvatīṃ durgāṃ koṇeṣu vāmataḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Bhīmā</s>, <s>Śrī</s>, <s>Sarasvatī</s>, <s>Durgā</s> — to the left in the corners.

children.text: bāhyakoṇeṣu mudrā vai āsāmeva tu saṃlikhet // 5 //
children.translated_text: In the outer corners, one should draw the <s>mudrā</s>s of these very ones. // 5 //

body.text:
bāhyamaṇḍaleṣu punaryathāvaddevīḥ saṃlikhet /
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvadvidhivistaram // iti // 6 //
body.translated_text: In the outer <s>maṇḍala</s>s, one should again properly draw the goddesses. Hereafter I shall teach the elaboration of the procedure properly. Thus. // 6 //
Initiation into the <s>Maṇḍala</s>

body.text: athatra vajramaṇḍale yathākāmakaraṇīyatayā vajrāṅku śādibhiḥ samayakarma kṛtvā, vajradhārimudrāṃ yathāvad badhvā, brūyān "na kasyacittvayā adṛṣṭasamayastaitāḥ samayamudrāḥ purato vaktavyāḥ, na ca rahasyabhedaḥ kartavyaḥ" //
body.translated_text: Now in this <s>vajra</s>-<s>maṇḍala</s>, having performed the pledge-activities with the <s>vajra</s>-hook and the rest as one wishes, having properly bound the <s>vajra</s>-bearer <s>mudrā</s>, one should say: 'You must not speak those pledge-<s>mudrā</s>s before anyone who has not seen the pledge, nor should a breach of secrecy be made.'

body.text: tatastatkarmavajraṃ vajradhārimudrāyāmupari sthāpya, yathāvatpraveśayet / praveśya tadvajraṃ tathaiva kṣipet / yatra patati sāsya samayamudrā vaśya bhavati ā // tayā sarvakarmāṇi karoti //
body.translated_text: Then, having placed that activity-<s>vajra</s> upon the <s>vajra</s>-bearer <s>mudrā</s>, one should properly cause entry. Having entered, one should cast that <s>vajra</s> in the same manner. Wherever it falls, that becomes one's pledge-<s>mudrā</s> to be mastered. With that, one performs all activities.

body.text: tato mukhabandhaṃ muktvā, maṇḍalaṃ yathāvad darśayitvā, samayamudrārahasyaṃ brūyāt /
body.translated_text: Then, having released the mouth-seal, having properly shown the <s>maṇḍala</s>, one should reveal the secret of the pledge-<s>mudrā</s>:

children.translated_text: These are your pledge-<s>mudrā</s>s, auspicious, performing all activities.
[They are] mothers, sisters, wives, daughters, and attendants. Thus.

body.text: tatrāsyā hṛdayaṃ bhavati oṃ sarvavajragāmini sarvabhakṣe sādhaya guhyavajriṇi hūṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: Therein, this is the heart[-mantra]: 'Oṃ! O <s>sarvavajragāminī</s>, all-devouring one, accomplish, O <s>guhyavajriṇī</s>! Hūṃ phaṭ!'

body.text: "anayā sakṛjjaptayā sarvastriyo vaśīkṛtyopabhoktavyāḥ, adharmo na bhavati / yathābhirucittaśca sarvabhujtva sādhyāḥ / tataḥ sarvaśuddhicittatāmavetya, sarvamudrāmanasottamānyapi sarvakarmāṇi kurvantī" tyāha bhagavān vajradharaḥ //
body.translated_text: <s>Bhagavān Vajradhara</s> said: 'By this, recited even once, having brought all women under one's power, they are to be enjoyed — it is not <s>adharma</s>. And whatever is desired may be accomplished through the enjoyment of all. Then, having understood the state of complete purity of mind, even the foremost of all <s>mudrā</s>-minds performs all activities.'
<s>Mudrā</s>
Next, the pledge-<s>mudrā</s>s should be taught:

body.text:
samayakrodhāṅgulī mūrdhni hṛdaye vajradṛḍhīkṛtā /
mukhorṇā ca mukhoddhāntā mūrdhni sthāpya dvidhikṛte // ti // 1 //
body.translated_text: The pledge-wrathful-finger at the crown, made firm as <s>vajra</s> at the heart, the face-spiral emitted from the mouth, placed at the crown divided in two. Thus. // 1 //

children.translated_text: By the binding of the left <s>vajra</s>-tip, one should press the trident-body.

children.text: anayā bandhayā samyak sidhyed vidyottamaḥ svayam // 2 //
children.translated_text: By this binding properly, the supreme <s>vidyā</s> itself is accomplished. // 2 //
For all <s>vajra</s>-families, the grasping of the left <s>vajra</s>-tip —
I shall teach the <s>mudrā</s>-binding of the pledges according to the rite. // 3 //

children.text: cakrā sarvāṅgasaṃpīḍā ghaṇṭā mudrā tathaiva ca /
children.translated_text: The wheel, the all-body pressing, the bell-<s>mudrā</s> likewise,
and the <s>oṃkāra</s>-<s>mudrā</s>, with the lion-ear grasping. // 4 //

body.translated_text: <s>Mudrā</s>-king [-<s>mudrā</s>s].

children.text: jvālā parigrahā caiva prabhā saṃgrahameva ca /
children.translated_text: The flame-grasping, and the radiance-grasping,
the staff-fist-grasping, reversed from the mouth.

body.translated_text: Wrathful pledges.

children.text: pānamudrā ca mālā ca vajrā ca ṣṭaṃbhanāmitā /
children.translated_text: The drinking-<s>mudrā</s>, the garland, the <s>vajra</s>, and the paralyzing one,
stationed at the crown — these are the courtesans, the <s>maṇḍala</s> door-guardians.

body.translated_text: Courtesan pledges.

children.translated_text: The arm-contraction-wheel, reversed from behind,
the flame, the releasing of sparks, stationed in the split mouth.

body.translated_text: Messenger pledges.

children.translated_text: The mouth entered from both ends, pressing and causing to fall,

children.text: bāhuveṣṭanaveṣṭā ca sahasā hāriṇī tathe // ti //
children.translated_text: the arm-entwining-wrap, and the sudden stealer. Thus.

body.translated_text: Servant pledges.

The elaboration of the procedure of the <s>maṇḍala</s> of the <s>vajra</s> of all <s>vajra</s>-families, from the great <s>kalpa</s>-king of the <s>vajra</s>-pledge of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s, is fully completed.

body.text:
CHAPTER 13 SARVA-VAJRA-KULA-DHARMA-SAMAYA-MANDALA-VIDHI-VISTARA
Emanation of deities from samadhi
body.translated_text:
CHAPTER 13: <s>SARVA-VAJRA-KULA-DHARMA-SAMAYA-MAṆḌALA-VIDHI-VISTARA</s>
Emanation of Deities from <s>Samādhi</s>

body.text: atha bhagavāṃ punarapi sarvatathāgatadharmasamayasaṃbhavavajrādhiṣṭhānannāma samādhiṃ samāpadyemāṃ svavidyottamāmabhāṣat oṃ vajra vit //
